results.title: A Russian state firm will map more than half of Mali. Who will own the data? | African Arguments
results.snippet: Since 2023, Mali’s mining code gives the state a free stake of at least 10 percent in a new operating company and an option to buy up to 20 percent more. The company must also cede 5 percent to Malian investors through a state company. State and national participation can therefore reach 35 percent, up from 20.
